family.description: This arginine rich domain is found at the C-terminal end of YjiS from Salmonella Typhimurium and similar short sequences from proteobacteria. YjiS, an inner membrane-associated small protein, acts as as a suppressor of flagella production, leading to pathogen escape from infected host cells [[cite:PUB00160930]]. In the plant pathogen Agrobacterium tumefaciens, some small proteins that contain this domain are involved in nutrient acquisition and central carbon metabolism [[cite:PUB00160928]]. CcaF1 from Rhodobacter sphaeroides is an RNA binding protein that has a role in the oxidative stress defence [[cite:PUB00160929]]. In some uncharacterised proteins, this domain, previously known as DUF1127, covers the whole sequence.
family.name: YjiS-like domain

causal_graphs.family_mapping: RSP_6037 is reference Q3J4N6, sequence version 1, 71 residues; PF06568 spans 28-60. Current taxonomy calls this strain Cereibacter sphaeroides; the experiment does not isolate the domain.
causal_graphs.limitations: Overexpression effects do not prove native-dose necessity or intrinsic nuclease activity. Binding is not a degradation reaction; other transcripts and growth regimes require separate assessment.
causal_graphs.scope: R. sphaeroides 2.4.1 carrying pRKCcaF1 compared with wild type; full-length RSP_6037, not the KD131 homolog.
